selected_evidence.requirement: Public-key-only SSH for ssh-access members; root, contractor, passwords, and interactive PTYs denied
selected_evidence.summary: Effective sshd policy requires publickey and ssh-access, disables password/keyboard-interactive and root access, and explicitly denies contractor. Live tests show opsadmin non-interactive success and PTY, contractor-password, and root failures.

selected_evidence.requirement: Dedicated ssh-admin boundary allows node2 and blocks node3
selected_evidence.summary: ssh-admin contains source 10.100.6.11/32 and SSH; public has no SSH. Node2 succeeds while node3 receives a network-layer rejection, including after restarts.

selected_evidence.requirement: Prepared accounts, keys, and data preserved
selected_evidence.summary: The opsadmin key fingerprint remained SHA256:9YfbD75uiEP1VfjwCqzbmx5wJUeWyzavXTa15hBfmds; prepared data hashes, accounts, permissions, and node2 key state remained intact.

Boot ID changed from c207ab79-d913-4af0-b630-8f0104ee3ccd to e8d9bce7-1c45-4f3a-9d00-9774711d738e. sshd, sshprobe account/key state, and live access to node1 recovered.
Boot ID changed from a0d04bc6-5f90-4c7b-8283-51dd6932056f to e5bc8e6f-6bda-425d-9f46-eac35985c09c. sshd and stable machine data recovered, while access to node1 TCP/22 remained blocked.
